text:
Ivy Tran: quick report from the RN bootcamp breakout  attendees building the mobile sample hit a weird SSE + json_mode interaction when the app refreshes auth mid-stream.
Omar Hassan: are they using fetch streaming or EventSource? RN environment can be funky.
Ivy Tran: EventSource polyfill (rn-eventsource) to keep SSE live. flow: model streams function_call JSON -> client parses -> token expires -> auth refresh -> EventSource reconnects and sends remaining frames. Parser errors with 'Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0' or 'Extra data after top-level value'.
Becky Li: that sounds like the reconnect frames include an HTML auth page or an extra SSE comment frame. RN polyfills sometimes emit a reconnect event with a small prelude.
Ivy Tran: exact console snippet I saved: "parser error: Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0
  at parseJSON (sdk/js/parser.js:98)" then later "SyntaxError: Extra data after top-level value" when retry happened.
Omar Hassan: two distinct failure modes: 1) non-JSON reconnect payload (HTML or keepalive) breaking strict parser, 2) concatenated JSON objects across reconnects because parser buffer wasn't reset. Fixes: sanitize non-JSON SSE lines before handing to JSON-mode parser, and always reset stream buffer on reconnect/retry.
Becky Li: RN-specific: our SDK's EventSource wrapper doesn't expose a 'reset()' method. Bootcamp folks ended up manually instantiating new parser instances which is ugly and confusing.
Ivy Tran: suggestion: add an explicit RN note in the sample README: "If you use EventSource polyfills, ensure you filter out non-json SSE comments and create a fresh parser after reconnect". But we should also ship a nicer SDK API.
Omar Hassan: propose a small helper: client.responses.stream({..., json_mode: true, streaming_adapter: 'eventsource'}) returns an object with `dispose()` and `resetOnReconnect: true|false`. When true, SDK will automatically tear down parser and re-initialize on 401/reconnect.
Becky Li: plus an opt-in sanitize option: `sse_strip_comments: true` which drops any SSE lines starting with ":" or "retry:" prior to parsing. That will reduce confusing errors for newbies.
Ivy Tran: also add a log-level guidance in bootcamp slides: show how to capture raw SSE frames when debugging (small snippet). People spent 10 minutes staring at a SyntaxError without knowing how to inspect frames.
Omar Hassan: operationally: open two tickets: one SDK enhancement for streaming adapter reset + sanitize (DEVEX-1460), and one bootcamp docs update with RN troubleshooting + example (DEVEX-1461). I'll take the SDK ticket.
CI Bot: New issue created: DEVEX-1460 - "Streaming adapters: reset parser & sanitize SSE frames for json_mode" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DEVEX-1460 :white_check_mark:
Becky Li: I'll PR the RN README and add a tiny test in bootcamp that simulates an auth refresh mid-sse stream (we can replay captured frames).
Ivy Tran: thanks team. Also can we add a short note in the SDK changelog when this lands so onboarding trainers can point to it in future sessions?
Omar Hassan: will add changelog entry and a small migration note for RN users. ETA: SDK PR by tomorrow, docs PR same day.
Becky Li: saved another demo, hooray :party_parrot: 
Ivy Tran: closing loop: we'll also add the helper to the sample mobile code so new hires don't need to implement their own reconnection logic.
